author: WaterNinja1O1X
quote: There is nothing bad I can find in this game, it is a faithful remake story wise to the original Re4 (2005). Now there are slight changes to the story that makes this one different in its ownright. Changes to the gameplay like parrying, slight dodging, and new guns. Some areas are remodeled and changes to give it a fresh feeling while still leaving space to enjoy the original. Almost making them seem like Two completely different games.

author: WaterNinja1O1X
quote: Domt get me wrong, this game is a phenomenal remake after the original 2001 release, my only issue are the recent updates that make the game buggier/lagging on consoles, otherwise, withoit the issues, this game is reinventing horror, bringing back the classic with over the shoulder camera angles, new areas and puzzles, references to the original game, fantastic graphics and slight changes to parts that were clunky. This game is super enjoyable but different enough to always appreciate and enjoy the original 2001 SH2.

author: WaterNinja1O1X
quote: This game is just Iconic with the Fog, atmosphere, and the innovation of being creative by using the fog as a way to look past the consoles limitations, making the game look great for future replayablity. A must play for any old school horror game fans

author: WaterNinja1O1X
quote: This game is filled with bugs, lag, and alot of delay if your near too many Npcs, the frame drop. For some reason the physics are just weird. It feels unfinished and feels like another cyberpunk release. This shouldve stayed in the oven a whole longer.
